architecture.system_overview: Tauri v2 native cross-platform application (macOS, Windows, Android) delivering a high-performance, pure monochrome (#000000 / #0a0a0c / #141416 / #ffffff) ASCII rendering studio. Features a node constellation graph representing processing pipelines, technical status stickers, a single orchestrated entrance load animation, and an ultra-reliable video/image/camera extraction pipeline with zero AI-slop.

windows.webview: Microsoft Edge WebView2 (Chromium Evergreen) with Direct3D 12

android.packaging: Android APK & AAB package via Tauri CLI

visual_identity.design_philosophy: Luxury deep monochrome dark-mode UI inspired by professional node graph architectures (Cortex, Quant, Aelf, Meeton). Pure #000000 true black background, deep graphite surfaces (#0a0a0c, #141416), crisp 1px borders (#222224), pure white active highlights (#ffffff), zinc secondary typography (#a1a1aa), and monospaced telemetry chips. Zero colorful gradients, zero neon glows, zero AI-slop badges.

video_pipeline.execution_flow: 1. User drops/picks video file -> 2. URL.createObjectURL creates blob URL -> 3. Offscreen HTMLVideoElement initialized with muted=true, playsInline=true -> 4. Video await loadeddata & play() -> 5. rVFC loop extracts frames into 2D canvas with willReadFrequently:true -> 6. Canvas getImageData extracts pixel buffer -> 7. Pixel buffer converted to monochrome ASCII characters -> 8. Rendered to AsciiCanvas viewport -> 9. Clean cancelVideoFrameCallback & URL.revokeObjectURL on tab change or stop.
video_pipeline.fallback_mechanism: If requestVideoFrameCallback is unsupported, automatically fall back to requestAnimationFrame loop bound to video.paused / video.ended state with 500ms heartbeat.

image_pipeline.execution_flow: 1. User selects image file -> 2. Preflight downsamples max dimension to 2048px preserving aspect ratio -> 3. Offscreen canvas rasterizes image to exact targetColumns x targetRows -> 4. getImageData extracts RGBA buffer -> 5. Monochrome contrast/brightness/gamma LUT converts brightness to ASCII characters -> 6. Instant viewport rendering with char count telemetry.

camera_pipeline.execution_flow: 1. User requests camera -> 2. MediaEngineService.startCamera() calls navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia -> 3. Video track streams to hidden preview element -> 4. Frame extraction loop feeds ASCII engine at target FPS -> 5. One-click snapshot draws current frame to canvas and generates PNG snapshot.

motion_lifecycle.entry: Single orchestrated matrix cascade reveal on load (duration 1.4s, cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1))
motion_lifecycle.unmount_cleanup: Video element paused and src revoked, cancelVideoFrameCallback and RAF canceled, camera tracks stopped, canvas contexts scrubbed

breaking_scenarios.name: Unsupported Video Codec or Corrupted Container
breaking_scenarios.vector: User drops an MKV with unsupported AV1/HEVC codec or 0-byte corrupt file into dropzone
breaking_scenarios.vulnerability_surface: HTMLVideoElement triggers 'error' event; unhandled promise rejection in ensureVideoPlaying() or silent black output
breaking_scenarios.expected_defense: HTMLVideoElement error listener intercepts error code MEDIA_ERR_SRC_NOT_SUPPORTED; pipeline catches error, rejects cleanly, sets user-friendly error sticker 'CODEC_UNSUPPORTED', and preserves existing canvas without blank screen
breaking_scenarios.recovery_action: Display inline error message explaining supported codecs (MP4, WebM), clean up Blob URL, and reset dropzone state to idle

breaking_scenarios.name: Rapid Mode Switching During Active 60 FPS Video Loop
breaking_scenarios.vector: User selects high-bitrate video, clicks play, and immediately rapid-clicks between 'video', 'camera_stream', and 'procedural_3d' tabs at 10Hz
breaking_scenarios.vulnerability_surface: Orphaned requestVideoFrameCallback handles writing to detached canvas context; memory leak of unmounted HTMLVideoElements; audio playback continuing in background
breaking_scenarios.expected_defense: Active stream controller cancelVideoFrameCallback() and video.pause() executed synchronously in useEffect cleanup; offscreen canvas context released; video.src revoked; only single active loop executes
breaking_scenarios.recovery_action: Enforce strict cancellation token on all frame callbacks; destroy prior pipeline before mounting new active tab

breaking_scenarios.name: Large 4K/8K Image Buffer Causing Canvas Allocation OOM
breaking_scenarios.vector: User uploads 8192x8192 high-resolution uncompressed camera RAW/PNG
breaking_scenarios.vulnerability_surface: Calling getImageData on an 8K canvas creates a 268MB TypedArray, freezing the main UI thread or crashing the webview process
breaking_scenarios.expected_defense: Image preflight downsamples input image directly using an offscreen downsampling canvas with maxDimensionPx=2048 before rasterizing to grid dimensions (max 400x300 = 120,000 cells max); UI thread never touches >2048px buffers
breaking_scenarios.recovery_action: Clamp image dimensions during initial drawImage call; cap maximum output columns to 400 and rows to 300

breaking_scenarios.name: Operating System Camera Permission Denial or Device In-Use Conflict
breaking_scenarios.vector: User switches to Live Camera tab while macOS / Windows privacy setting has camera access disabled, or another app holds exclusive lock
breaking_scenarios.vulnerability_surface: navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia rejects; unhandled rejection leaves camera state in infinite 'requesting_permission' spinner
breaking_scenarios.expected_defense: MediaEngineService catches NotAllowedError / TrackStartError; updates MediaPickerError state with PERMISSION_DENIED; renders inline permission recovery dialog with 'Open System Settings' and 'Retry' buttons; gracefully restores idle state
breaking_scenarios.recovery_action: Present permission recovery UI; provide clear guidance for macOS System Settings / Windows Privacy settings

breaking_scenarios.name: Desktop Window Snap / Rapid Resize During Continuous 60 FPS Render
breaking_scenarios.vector: User maximizes or snaps Tauri desktop window between 800x600 and 3840x2160 during continuous video ASCII playback
breaking_scenarios.vulnerability_surface: Canvas dimensions reallocated 60 times per second causing canvas buffer thrashing, flickering, and dropped frame bursts
breaking_scenarios.expected_defense: StreamPipeline debounces resize listener with 16ms clamp; canvas maintains fixed ASCII character aspect ratio; rendering continues uninterrupted without memory reallocation thrash
breaking_scenarios.recovery_action: Debounce resize updates to render frame boundary; reuse existing canvas bitmap backing store
